name: Mortal Kombat Trilogy — Story
notes: Primary game story text preserved by Mortal Kombat Warehouse. It states that Liu Kang and his comrades were lured into Outworld to compete in a second tournament, and that the tournament was merely a diversion within Shao Kahn's scheme to break the Elder Gods' rules through Sindel's reincarnation on Earth Realm. This both confirms the second tournament occurred and gives it a second, scheme-level causal context distinct from Shang Tsung's explicit lure plan in Mortal Kombat II.
